about: The text of the gated MCU images told by who owns it (scripts/lib/text_owner_gate.py, docs/text-ownership.md). Each row holds the image's text and the bytes of every owner of the symbol table of the linked ELF; a change that moves the text or an owner by more than its tolerance moves the row in the same commit, with the reason in `measured`. An owner is the owner of the SYMBOL: code inlined at link time is counted under the symbol that carries it.

zephyr-client-fixed.measured: 2026-10-28, scripts/kit-lane.sh build on the parity tree at origin's round 3826. The first reading of the owners, from the compare build of run 20261028T005644 (text 176,352), put the single-threaded zenoh-pico image's own code at about 55 KB against about 92 KB of wz's own (wz_session_core, c:wz_, wz_session_mcu, wz_codecs, sce_rust_runtime, wz_runtime_coop, keccak, core, compiler_builtins, wz_runtime_zephyr); the platform (the Zephyr network stack, the board's drivers, the toolchain) is the same size in both. The row first read 174,100 bytes with `keccak` at 2,164, the SHAKE128 permutation of the initial sequence number's derivation (src/initial_sn.rs), which zenoh-pico does not carry; with CONFIG_WZ_INITIAL_SN_COMPACT (this image's overlay turns it on) the permutation is not linked and the text was 171,692. With CONFIG_WZ_SUBSCRIBE=n (the overlay's too) the declaration of a subscriber and the registry that keeps the latest sample of each are not linked: 169,300, 2,392 bytes less, wz_session_core 2,006 of them, and 960 bytes less of bss. The reply writer now writes the responder's identity and an Err itself, so the codec's builder path (ResponseWriter::encode_generic and the heapless::Vec pushes of whole extension entries it makes) is not reachable and not linked when no build feature can stage a timestamp, an attachment or a source info: 167,148, 2,152 bytes less, wz_codecs 1,232 of them. The connect manager's `drive` and `ask` take the planner's call as a trait object, so each is one copy and not one for each of its thirteen callers: 164,488, 2,660 bytes less, c:wz_ (the main function with what it inlines) 2,618 of them. The session's link driver is named by its type (`SessionRuntime::Driver`, `SlotSink<D>`, `TxLease<D>`) where the image's Kconfig chose it, so the session's calls through the link are direct calls the compiler inlines and not calls through a trait object's table: 162,784, 1,704 bytes less (wz_session_core 922 of them).
